landing.heroSubtitle: GPS-guided audio walking tours, museum guides and AI itineraries for independent travelers. Hands-free, in your language.
landing.step1Body: Browse curated cities and pick a tour that fits your time and mood.

landing.tripsBody: Split the trip expenses and see who owes whom — the people you invite do not need an account.
